explication: uniTerm is a cross-platform remote-access workspace: users select a saved connection or workspace, open a terminal or specialized session, and interact with remote systems through a shared tabbed UI. The session manager dispatches connection types to protocol-specific implementations; separate product branches provide file transfer, databases, desktops, monitoring, containers, Kubernetes, and AI. The README documents these capabilities, while the sampled source confirms the Wails frontend/backend boundary, session dispatch, and selected subsystem behavior. Wiring for unsampled branches is shown only where documented.
